reviews.author: Josh Pagano
reviews.text: Fantastic place for a state inspection! I had no appointment. They finished up the guy in front of me in 10 mins. They had my car inspected in 5 mins. I was in and out in like 15 mins. Very impressed :)

reviews.author: Micah Hudnall
reviews.text: Terrible. I have taken my truck to them 3 times now. Each time something has been wrong. Took it to them to get a bolt fixed and they held it for 4 weeks until I got it back. Then I took it to get oil leak fixed and got it back but my belt was ruined so I had to take it back to get that fixed since they ruined it. Thirdly I had them replace my ball joints and come to find out later down the road they installed them incorrectly and made a make shift bolt/screw that has ruined everything instead of replacing it with the actual bolt. I’m not happy at all with them and will not be going back. They have lost business and this is atrocious.

reviews.author: Adam McCormick
reviews.text: These guys are great. There is nothing fancy about this place but they are reasonable and honest. My family has trusted Roger Marion Automotive for years. If you live in Lewisville or Clemmons they are a trustworthy place for car inspections and other mechanical work.

reviews.author: Joseph Fritz
reviews.text: Were able to get me in fast with no appointment, and I was in and out - inspection and oil change took about a half hour.

reviews.author: Nicole Mott
reviews.text: We’ve always had great experiences with Roger Marion. They always get us in right away, do excellent work, and charge a fair price. Today, they did a repair on our son’s used car. Knowing he’s a new driver, they not only checked everything over for safety, Roger also handed him his card and told him if he ever breaks down and can’t get in touch with mom & dad, to give them a call, and they will come help him. Can’t beat that kind of care and service!

reviews.author: Tobias
reviews.text: Great place to take your car. I've been taking mine there for a few years now, and they've always been great. Customer service has been good. Sometimes I'll need rides to/from, and they always arrange these. One key factor for me in mechanics is honesty, since most of us don't know enough about cars. The Roger Marion guys will tell me, and not charge me, when something *doesn't* need to be fixed, or if they suspect they made a mistake. That's huge. And of course they also do a great job. Recommended.

reviews.author: Jon Will
reviews.text: First time using this shop yesterday. Pricing is fair, work is timely and honest. I had to get my starter replaced. The job was done in less than 24hrs. Great quality shop!

reviews.author: Roxanne Baer
reviews.text: Great service, Great people!! I can't say enough about how thankful I am for them! I was on my way home to VA from TN and started having some issues with my van, this was the nearest auto shop. They diagnosed my problem, replaced the part, and I didn't have any more issues driving home. THANK YOU!!!!

reviews.author: renee miller
reviews.text: Heading up to the mountains from Greensboro, no air conditioning. Stopped here at Roger Marion! They took excellent care of us right away, fixed our air conditioning and we were on the road within 45 minutes. They were attentive, friendly, and had a great air-conditioned office for us to wait in. I highly recommend this family owned business!

reviews.author: D Joy
reviews.text: Let me start by saying I was in NC on a business trip and heard a very loud noise coming from under the hood. You can imagine the FEAR that needing car repairs as an out of state individual. Having what looked like a very FULL schedule of business the owner still took the time to personally look at my truck and determined that it needed a Belt. I explained that I had just dropped my wife off at a restaurant down the street and would run pick her up and be right back. Mr. Marion instructed an employee to get a vehicle for me to go pick her up so he could get started on the repairs. WOW, he had known me all of 2 minutes, WOW. I picked up my wife and returned to his shop while they made the repairs. Knowing that we were under tremendous time constraint as our girls needed to be picked up 3 hours away. They completed the repair so fast and with no appointment and the cost was...wait for it.... probably less than if my shop back home had done it. WOW! The only negative to our experience was one of the guys in the office ate most of the sushi my wife bought for lunch...ROFL, just kidding. He is actually my hero as every piece he ate was one less my wife wouldn't try to make me eat, Thank you! Sushi, Try some fried chicken! Seriously, everyone we met was so wonderful. I pray God will continue to bless you, your business and all the work of your hands!

reviews.author: Beth Roberts
reviews.text: Roger Marion has done work on the vehicles that myself and several people I know. Everyone who works for him is kind and courteous and his prices match if not beats others. I highly recommend Roger Marion Automotive for anyone looking for that hometown feel!

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.text: I heard about Roger Marion because my partner's family has used this shop for years. Went for a tire replacement and alignment and the service was great! Very friendly, professional, and you even get a lender car to use if your service is going to take a few hours. I definitely recommend this shop!

reviews.author: Alexandra Hill
reviews.text: These gentlemen have worked on our cars numerous times. Every single time they have been transparent, honest and provided quality work. We won’t take our cars anywhere else! They go above and beyond to serve their customers!

reviews.author: Shelley Bowen
reviews.text: Huge shout out to Roger & Ben Marion! I was in a bind with my blocked AC drain. They got me in and taken care of quickly. The price was very reasonable. This is a good honest shop. You can trust them. Can’t recommend highly enough!!! Thank you!

reviews.author: Josh Hudnall
reviews.text: My family and I have been going here for years. There’s a reason for that; the level of honesty and transparency is unmatched. For me, as someone who doesn’t understand cars too well, I’ve always experienced great communication. They not only tell me the problem, they explain it and teach me how to recognize, avoid, and deal with the issue for future reference. What I am most appreciative about is their understanding of how essential our cars are to us. They always get the job done properly but also in a timely fashion. I would 10/10 times recommend anyone go here for their car troubles.

reviews.author: Connie Chesner
reviews.text: Friendly and efficient, fair and kind, the services at Roger Marion are always top-notch and I trust them with my vehicles. They are honest about what HAS to be done, versus what they might like to do and always respect your decision and budget. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Ansel White
reviews.text: I've been going to Rogers for years now. He gave me a spare tire when I was broke and starting a new job and had a flat. I've continued going to his shop after I got everything together and he's been the best mechanic I could imagine. Took me three weeks to get back to him to pay for the tire he gave me. Recently went to him to fix a nail in my tire and he fit me in. Also replaced a break light for me. On a scale of 1-10 it doesn't justify his service. He's kind and does what he can for people. I couldn't recommend a better place to have work done on your car.

reviews.author: Stacey DeJesus
reviews.text: This is a Veteran Owned Company, which automatically gets a thumbs up in my book! I was in and out of there in less than 10 minutes for an inspection. I would definitely recommend them if you need anything done in a hurry!

reviews.author: Jami B
reviews.text: Very nice staff. Really good prices. Excellent work on repairs. 100% recommend utilizing this place. You will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Lauren
reviews.text: I couldn’t be more pleased with the service I received! They were fast, fairly priced, and gave me a ride home. Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Terrence Cook
reviews.text: Work took way longer then I was told it would and the cost was way over quoted and I never received a phone call with price difference. Not to mention the mechanic was very unprofessional and even suggested I bring my truck after hours and he would do the work for a “better deal”. I won’t ever take my vehicle there again nor recommend this establishment. The office worker who answered my call was very rude as well. Definitely not a very friendly place and the mechanics were horrible.

reviews.author: beth angle
reviews.text: Roger Marion has done work on my vehicles for 12 years. This week I came in to ask how to use the special latch Roger Marion automotive, put on my daughters vehicle after an accident. The employee did not understand request and started trying to work on the latch. Causing hood not to close. I left vehicle to be fixed and came back to worse. Then thrown off property by owner. Owner blatantly lied about latch , lied about employee , and had no regard for damages to vehicle. Although my daughter and I and his son Coleman Marion witnessed the damage being done. Even after making them aware he was damaging car they did nothing to repair only make worse. Text me to pick up car after closing and after dark on Saturday in the rain hoping I wouldn’t notice. Then when asked about damage was thrown off the lot.

reviews.author: Samuel Wood
reviews.text: Took them 4 tries over 3 months to “replace” my trucks clutch. After I got the truck back, it felt no different than the day I brought it in. I finally took it to a different shop that fixed it in a day and a half. They showed me the parts that Roger Marion put in, random holes drilled in the pressure plate in order to hold it on, as well as other sketchy “workmanship.” Both I and the other mechanic were surprised that Roger Marion’s work didn't break and cause a crash while I was driving it. I eventually called back to see if there was a way I could get my money back, or someway to make it right. I was met with rude remarks and arrogance from the man answering the phone. He promised a call back from Roger himself, but after 3 months I have received no call. Almost $1000 down the drain. I seriously recommend you to go to any other auto shop.

reviews.author: COurtney Johnson
reviews.text: I have taken my car to this auto shop several times. The customer service is good! However I have had continuous problems with my vehicle. Some of my family members has taken their vehicles to the same auto shop and from their experience-their cars are needing more work as well! I just got a coolant tube and new water pump on my car! And my car is still not holding coolant in my car and that was a 586 dollar job! I wish they perform actual diagnostic tests on cars before picking an item they assume is wrong to fix.

reviews.author: Kevin Small
reviews.text: Brought my Toyota Camry to Roger Marion for a suspected timing belt break. No appointment and near the end of the week, so it took about two days. What I loved about RM is they offered a free loaner car while they fixed the belt. I had an alternate car of my own, so I didn't need it, but knowing they were willing to provide for my transportation needs impressed me. They were friendly and knowledgeable and had my car running better than it did before the belt broke. I wouldn't hesitate to use their services in the future.

reviews.author: Hannah Wilcox
reviews.text: If you are a woman, do not trust Roger Marion. My truck was brought in with no issues other than an oil pressure switch that needed to be changed. Upon picking up it started ticking and misfiring. Issues that were not issues when dropped off. When asked about why the problems just started I was hatefully asked if I even knew where the spark plugs were. Coleman gaslight me, made assumptions of my intelligence as a woman and accused me of drinking. However, upon entering the office to troubleshoot issues a whole bottle of liquor was son the floor. No ownership of responsibility or regard for the safety of clientel.

reviews.author: Ray Mitchell
reviews.text: You always get great service at a great price. Many times, less than you would expect and always far less than a dealership or big chain. Roger and his team are fair and honest and will make sure the job is done right.

reviews.author: Michele Prevette
reviews.text: Great service starting from the time they answer the phone to the end when you pick up your vehicle. Excellent quick turnaround and they fixed up my truck $90 less than Meneike quoted. Will definitely return.

reviews.author: Ryan Smithson
reviews.text: They always do a good job, but be prepared for an interesting customer experience. These people bend over backward to do the right thing.

reviews.author: Ted Pegram
reviews.text: Roger and his staff are superb. There is so much knowledge in that shop. Ive never had an issue with a vehicle that they could not fix. If they think a repair cost is not worth the value of the vehicle, he ll let you know that too. Very honest and reputable automotive services they provide

reviews.author: Sarah Casey
reviews.text: My mom has gone to Roger for years and he has kept a number of cars running long past their expiration date for her. Having recently purchased my own car, a 2008 (and rather finicky) Jeep, Roger and his guys have been wonderful. Roger runs an honest and accommodating business. Can't recommend them enough.

reviews.author: Steven Denton
reviews.text: Awesome service here today! Dropped in unexpected needing a car inspection and they worked me right in. Staff here was very friendly and I will be back for any mechanic needs. They give you an honest vibe and I didn’t feel sold to or deceived like many other places.

reviews.author: Nathan Reeder
reviews.text: Roger and his crew are great, fixed my pinion seal and a mystery clicking noise coming from my front tire, they did exactly as promised and are very reasonably priced, I will definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Tim Nolan
reviews.text: Honest, friendly, and diligent. After replacing my water pump, they noticed my tail lights were out and replaced them for free. Just really good folks over here

reviews.author: Helen Milner
reviews.text: So friendly. Helped me out so much, and was very respectful. Did a great job with my van! Could not have went to a better place. Love it. Will always be my mechanic. Thanks again The Milner girls

reviews.author: Tony Watts
reviews.text: Repair was done ok. Labor and part quotes were too far off for me. Part price was almost double what all local part stores show it to be. Labor $100 over quote. $400 to replace a power steering pressure hose. With no call to verify the added cost. I hesitated to go there because that has happened with them before, but won't happen to me again.

reviews.author: Yvonne Hairston
reviews.text: This place is amazing. The staff is the greatest. The owner is just awesome!! They'll work with you and are very considerate. I highly recommend this place to anyone having car issues. Trust me, you want be disappointed.

reviews.author: Dan Obergfell
reviews.text: Excellent job. Marion is the kind of honest, straightforward work I appreciate. Ben & Roger were great to work with on my older vehicle. Thanks guys. I’ll be back.

reviews.author: Tanya Lee
reviews.text: Roger Marion is the absolute best man and his crew is unbelievable their knowledge and efficiency and timely fashion is unbeatable.... won’t ever take my car anywhere else ... my new family !!! Gr8 job guys!!!

reviews.author: R Plummer
reviews.text: Rodger Marion Automotive in Clemmons North Carolina, is great customer service, and definitely will not break the bank when it comes to repairing your vehicle. Always up front and honest about repairs on your vehicle, never suggesting anything that you don't need like some other places. My wife and I take our vehicles and our daughter's vehicle there for repairs from now on since this is a family-owned business, and they are a pleasure to deal with.

reviews.author: justin benoit
reviews.text: Had a small problem I couldn't find. They told me what it most likely was in like 5 minutes or less. Then told me it would be much cheaper if I could do it myself. Not a hard swap and saved me tons of money.

reviews.author: Bruce Fails
reviews.text: These guys don't act like you should be able to diagnose and repair your own vehicle. They understand it is not usually a pleasant experience for the owner and they do their best to give you help and friendly service. They are so easy to talk to and deal with. Best auto repair service I have ever visited.

reviews.author: Adam Raba
reviews.text: Went in to get a oil pressure sensor replaced...now my engine is ticking and not running properly.they said it is a spark plug and a lifter causing the problem now...it was running fine until we got it back from them.. they refused to fix whatever they did...seems like a scam...went in for something fairly simple now I'm looking at a 500 dollar tuneup and possibly a expensive lifter repair..seriously considering filing a civil claim ..this is my only vehicle and I can't afford another thousand dollar repair or another car...I don't recommend anybody going here

reviews.author: saran mason
reviews.text: I have been coming to roger for years.. he a good business man, professional and you want. Feel like u are being taken advantaged of like some women feel. He stands behind his work, never had a problem. I had moved to charlotte back in 2008 and let a person work on my suv... left me with wires and took my $$. Roger sent a tow truck and had it towed to Clemmons, NC fixed my suv , I will not let anybody else touch my SUV , but roger and it has over 230,000 miles and still going strong. Thanks roger and staff. :)

reviews.author: Antonio Cafolla
reviews.text: First time there yesterday, this will be the shop to take everytime my cars needs any repairs,very honest and reasonable. They go the extra miles to resolve your car issues. I am a customer for life, specially thanks to Gabriel,nice mechanic. Thank you

reviews.author: Fred Crater
reviews.text: Roger Marion has kept our vehicles running for over 25 years. He kept our kids cars running while in college and he keeps my 98 yr old mothers 1990 something Buick in top shape, so she didn't get stranded somewhere.

reviews.author: Nicholas Arnold
reviews.text: What a great place! Excellent customer service, quickly repaired my car and had me back on the road the exact day that they said they would, and very reasonable.

reviews.author: Nevziee
reviews.text: I took my car to get my power steering rack fixed, and they called me and told me it wasn’t the right part, not to mention they still charged me 370$ for it… on top of that they completely messed up my entire steering wheel alignment and made it crooked so I took it to my moms close friends shop and turns out I had the right part and it’s works perfectly fine, this shop is a scam full of people who don’t know how to do their job all they want is your money.

reviews.author: James C Drye jr
reviews.text: Roger and his team work on all my cars when they need it. His pricing is very good and he stands behind there work. From old to new he works on them all.

reviews.author: Christie Combs
reviews.text: My family and I have utilized Roger Marion ever since moving to NC and even after being away a decade and coming back the SERVICE AND QUALITY is the same!! Top notch!!

reviews.author: Connie Eastridge
reviews.text: Great, professional service. Affordable and definitely they'll find what's wrong with your vehicle where others can't. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: osvaldo mendez
reviews.text: Had an issue with work they had previously done on my car and they went above and beyond to take care of my issue.

reviews.author: Nancy Brewer
reviews.text: Marion's is a great place to have your car serviced or repaired. They do a great job, everyone is friendly yet professional, family-type environment and they have reasonable charges for their service

reviews.author: Jeff Deguire
reviews.text: Great communication, great service, fast service, fair prices, and they even drove my car home for me! We just moved to the area and I found my new mechanic!!

reviews.author: Patrick Gray
reviews.text: Took car in to have exhaust manifold bolt removed from block, they drilled out threads and damaged engine block. They charged me 400 dollars to remove said bolt. It is still in the engine block. Headed back when they open to resolve this issue with them. I will update. UPDATE he refunded me half the bill after much argument and said since his guys worked on it he had to charge me. Engine block is messed up and was never repaired. They tried putting a nut between the head of the bolt and manifold to take up the distance the bolt would not go in. Bolt was finger loose from threads being damaged during drilling.

reviews.author: Connie Ellis
reviews.text: Very dependable and did great work replacing the head gasket. I get my tires from here too. Good prices and great service

reviews.author: Lindsay Dentel
reviews.text: Our family has trusted Roger and team for decades! We often bring our vehicles from out of town for service. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Bob Callender
reviews.text: Roger and his staff never disappoint, they are able to find the problem the first, unlike many other shops. The prices are very fair. Great work.

reviews.author: Christina Vakalopoulos
reviews.text: I’d leave 10 stars if I could!! Honest, ethical, trustworthy… I could go on and on. Absolutely so grateful for this business and the wonderful people running it.

reviews.author: Barry Brown
reviews.text: My Miata needed a new clutch, the guys did an outstanding job! Very pleased will go back again for any future work!

reviews.author: Donald Shaw
reviews.text: Rudest person I ever spoke to. I called to see if they could check my car out and explained what my previous mechanic who retired said. He informed me he didn't care what he said just bring it to them. NEVER WILL GO BACK

reviews.author: kathryn Walters
reviews.text: Do not trust Roger Marion! He seems knowledgeable, and honest, but it is a farce. I was very surprised at the level of deceit from this automotive shop. Avoid this repair facility!

reviews.author: Patsy Teeler
reviews.text: This is the first time going to Roger Marion's. If he lets me, I will be back! I brought him quite the problem child, and the team never gave up. If they can't fix, Roger will find someone who can.

reviews.author: James Boone
reviews.text: Reliable, honest shop. I wouldn't take my cars anywhere else. Roger and his people are always friendly, knowledgeable, and honest.

reviews.author: Patrick McNeely
reviews.text: They replaced my power steering pump, and after it failed due to no fault of their own, they repaired it again at no charge. They provided excellent service, even a loaner vehicle, best service ever!!!!

reviews.author: Cameron McMullan
reviews.text: Never had any issues here, had a motor replaced several years ago, oil changes and inspections, no problems. V

reviews.author: Kenneth
reviews.text: I just had a oil change they didn't change the oil filter and charged me 87. Dollar for a oil change

reviews.author: G Miles
reviews.text: Wouldn't trust this troll. Had my truck for 11 months . Still wasn't done right!! How the hell he get 4.5 stars!! REALLY!!

reviews.author: Anthony Jenkins
reviews.text: Best all around mechanics and great atomsphere. Roger is very knowledgeable and always willing to go the extra mile.

reviews.author: Amara Hunter
reviews.text: Great service and people. I wouldn't go anywhere else as a woman. You won't get taken advantage of by the ownership.

reviews.author: bill gurganus
reviews.text: One too many costly experiences with service, ended up having another shop fix their mistakes. They've lost a long time customer.
